dedupe_keys.name: hong kong climate vegetation and topography rasters

description: The Hong Kong climate-raster research team publishes 30 m GIS layers describing terrestrial climate, vegetation, topography and urban development. Figshare lists GeoTIFF files for elevation, slope, aspect, terrain roughness, vegetation and distance to water among the deposited variables. The resource addresses spatial variation within Hong Kong that coarse global grids may smooth away. Version 2 is publicly available and free under CC-BY-4.0, with the dataset and its ESSD article both requested as citations. The inspected description does not give a common observation period or temporal sampling interval, so these remain unknown. A limitation is that the layers combine environmental characteristics, not measure the performance of drainage or cooling assets. They could supply terrain and environmental covariates for urban heat, runoff or infrastructure exposure simulations. The local grids complement regional climate products with finer spatial detail; numerical files and coordinate compatibility were not checked.
